_comment: Rami local AI model manifest. Hardware: RTX 4060 Laptop 8GB VRAM / i9-14900HX / 15.6GB RAM. See .private-context/architecture/local-ai-deployment.md for rationale.

models._default_note: Qwen3 8B — balanced default. ~4.7GB VRAM in q4_K_M quantization. Fits RTX 4060 8GB comfortably.
models._lightweight_note: Qwen3 4B — fallback for lower-VRAM machines or fast extraction calls. ~2.5GB VRAM.
models._quality_note: Qwen3 14B — optional higher-quality drafting. ~8-10GB VRAM in Q4; borderline for 8GB VRAM. Do NOT pull automatically. Pull manually only if testing justifies it.

embeddings._note: Phase-3 RAG embeddings. ~270MB. Not required until Phase 3 implementation.
